name: Jump with Fish
desc:
Welcome to Jump with Fish! 🐟
Squat with your fish to leap higher into the sky!

How to Play:
🏋️‍♂️ Squat to build up your fish power
💸 Jump higher to earn money for new fish
🚀 Reach new layers of the sky and show your ultimate skill

You literally jump even when you’re offline! 💤
